name.en: Art Nouveau · Forest with a Gold-Leaf Effect

classification.zh: 新艺术式装饰性森林童话插画
classification.en: An Art Nouveau-inspired decorative forest fairy-tale illustration

summary.zh: 金色枝叶织成浓密森林。深蓝夜色、朱红点缀与蜿蜒小径，共同建立华丽而神秘的童话空间。
summary.en: Golden branches and foliage weave a dense forest. Deep blue night, vermilion accents and a winding path together create a lavish, mysterious fairy-tale setting.

recognition.zh: 先看枝条的流动曲线与植物纹样，再看金色装饰。金色是这张参考图的配色选择。
recognition.en: Look first at the flowing curves of the branches and the botanical patterns, then at the gold ornament. Gold is a palette choice specific to this reference image.

reuse_focus.zh: 把流动曲线与装饰节奏嵌入原照片的枝叶、织物或建筑表面，保留冷暖关系与主要结构。
reuse_focus.en: Incorporate flowing curves and ornamental rhythms into the branches, foliage, textiles or architectural surfaces already in the photograph, preserving the warm–cool relationships and main structures.

judgment_note.zh: 按可见画面归类；作者、年代和真实媒介待补。“金箔”描述视觉效果。
judgment_note.en: Classification is based on the visible image; the artist, date and actual medium remain unverified. “Gold leaf” describes a visual effect.

caption.zh: 森林、金色小径与黑色狐狸
caption.en: Forest, golden path and black fox

alt.zh: 深蓝森林中金色树木和蜿蜒小径，前景有黑色狐狸与红蘑菇
alt.en: Golden trees and a winding path in a deep blue forest, with a black fox and red mushrooms in the foreground

credit.zh: 用户提供 · 作者待补

text.zh: 纤细树干与舒展枝条形成连续曲线；小径上的旋纹与树冠节奏相互呼应。
text.en: Slender trunks and spreading branches form continuous curves; the swirling patterns on the path echo the rhythms of the tree crowns.

text.zh: 深蓝、近黑建立背景，金赭与浅金铺陈枝叶，少量朱红形成局部焦点。
text.en: Deep blue and near-black establish the background, golden ochre and pale gold cover the branches and foliage, and small amounts of vermilion create local focal points.

text.zh: 金箔般的哑光装饰、细密勾线和重复叶片，带来织毯与装饰壁画的观感。
text.en: Matte ornament with a gold-leaf-like appearance, fine outlines and repeated leaves give the image the look of a tapestry or decorative mural.

text.zh: 高大树干形成竖向骨架；S 形小径从前景延伸，植物纹样与空间纵深并存。
text.en: Tall trunks form a vertical framework; an S-shaped path extends from the foreground, allowing botanical pattern and spatial depth to coexist.

text.zh: 夜色森林中的小动物与红蘑菇营造民间故事感；迁移时不需要把这些题材对象加入原照片。
text.en: Small animals and red mushrooms in the nighttime forest evoke a folktale; these subjects do not need to be added to the original photograph when transferring the style.

legacy_prompts.zh: 将输入照片改绘为新艺术式的金箔装饰森林童话插画。照片决定内容与构图；附加参考图只提供线条、配色和纹样，不导入参考中的人物、动物或物件。保留原图主体数量、身份特征、姿态、物件关系、视角和画幅。把已有枝条、轮廓与路径组织成优雅的有机曲线，以细密植物纹样和金色勾线强化装饰节奏。使用深蓝与近黑底色、金赭和浅金装饰，以及少量朱红焦点；金色呈哑光金箔般的绘画效果。兼顾平面纹样与必要的空间纵深，保留细微纸面和手绘纹理。人物面部与全画保持一致的插画语言。不要凭空添加狐狸、蘑菇、文字、边框或水印，避免摄影贴片与写实金属反光。
legacy_prompts.en: Reinterpret the input photograph as an Art Nouveau-inspired decorative forest fairy-tale illustration with a gold-leaf effect. The photograph determines content and composition; additional references supply only lines, palette and patterns, without importing their people, animals or objects. Preserve the original subject count, identifying features, poses, object relationships, viewpoint and framing. Organize existing branches, contours and paths into graceful organic curves, using intricate botanical patterns and gold outlines to reinforce ornamental rhythms. Use deep blue and near-black grounds, golden ochre and pale gold ornament, and small vermilion focal points; render gold as a matte, gold-leaf-like painted effect. Balance flat patterns with the spatial depth the scene needs, retaining subtle paper and hand-painted texture. Render faces in the same illustration style as the whole image. Do not invent foxes, mushrooms, text, borders or watermarks. Avoid photographic patches and realistic metallic reflections.
